name: td-reviewer-auto
description: Independent code reviewer running on the auto model (server-selected). One of two parallel reviewers for cross-model review. Reviews a change against the ordered lenses (logic/security/tests, plus conditional API/rollback/perf), grades findings P0-P3, and returns a [Pn] file:line list. Invoked by /td-review-cross; not meant to be called alone.
